movie.title: The Wing or the Thigh?
movie.overview: Charles Duchemin, a well-known gourmet and publisher of a famous restaurant guide, is waging a war against fast food entrepreneur Tri- catel to save the French art of cooking. After having agreed to appear on a talk show to show his skills in naming food and wine by taste, he is confronted with two disasters: his son wants to become a clown rather than a restaurant tester and he, the famous Charles Duchemin, has lost his taste!

facts: Did you know the film's protagonist, Charles Duchemin, is a renowned gourmet and publisher who's waging a culinary war against a fast food entrepreneur to protect traditional French cooking?
Before his personal troubles, Duchemin had agreed to appear on a talk show, ready to impress everyone by identifying food and wine purely by taste.

Talk about a bad day! Charles Duchemin faces a double whammy: his son wants to be a clown instead of a restaurant tester, and to top it off, Duchemin himself mysteriously loses his famous sense of taste!
